a.lede: The deal combines the two largest grocery delivery platforms in the US.
a.title: DoorDash acquires Instacart in $17 billion delivery service merger

b.lede: DoorDash has announced that it's buying Instacart in a deal valued at approximately $17 billion. The acquisition will give DoorDash a bigger presence in online grocery delivery via Instacart's established grocery marketplace and retailer partnerships. DoorDash, which started as a restaurant courier service, already has its own grocery delivery business, but that faces ongoing competition […]
b.title: DoorDash is acquiring Instacart for around $17 billion
